sourceAnchors.reason: SS3243 NKOP1 explicitly distinguishes null sentinel FFFFFFFF from empty length zero; the annotated nullable array must retain null and clone only present data. Constructor/caller null-versus-empty and cleanup tests independently verify this wire contract.

SS3243 nullable field bytes encode null and empty differently; returning an empty array for null would change the approved canonical payload fingerprint. Preserve the explicit nullable getter and defensive cloning, with independent null/empty fixtures.
Only the caller-owned enum values copy is mutated, then the independent fresh array is asserted to retain MATCH; no production null value or assignment is admitted.
